title: fallback prioritizer with predictive node hibernation
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: During a recent regional incident we observed frequent churn when standby nodes came back online: idle capacity would be immediately re-allocated, triggering cascading KV-sync and causing short-lived capacity oscillations that pushed SLO-sensitive tenants into circuit states. This PR introduces a telemetry-driven fallback prioritizer plus a predictive node hibernation controller to reduce churn and make regional failovers calmer. Goals: 1) Prioritize fallback and shed decisions using recent per-tenant request shape and success-rate deltas instead of simple token-rate thresholds. 2) Temporarily mark underutilized nodes as 'hibernating' during controlled warmup windows to avoid immediate re-inclusion in load balancing. 3) Emit observability signals and rollout knobs so SRE can tune behavior without code changes. Summary of changes: runtime/scheduler: new fallback_prioritizer.go with prioritization rules driven by sliding-window aggregates; orchestration/hibernate: predictive_hibernator.go controller that recommends hibernate/unhibernate actions based on predicted ramp and probe latency; telemetry: added two new histograms (fallback.priority_score, node.hibernate_probability) and a new composite metric fallback.regional_pressure; console: dashboard updates + a feature flag toggle; tests: unit tests for prioritizer, integration tests simulating cross-region restarts, e2e: synthetic scenario that reproduces the incident pattern. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind rollout.defer.prioritizer; staged canary to 10% of regions for 24h, then 50% for 12h, then global. Backport: cherrypick to release/1.12 (hotfix) included. Checklist: - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Telemetry and dashboard panels - [x] SLO regression tests run locally - [x] Ops runbook entry added (docs/ops/node-hibernate.md) - [x] Backport PR created to release/1.12 Links: Linear ENG-4621 (fallback prioritizer spec), SUP-345 (incident ticket).
